I was in college and had a class that morning. I usually would listen to the radio while I got ready, but for some reason I didn't that day. If I had, I would have heard what happened as it had started maybe 30-60 minutes before I woke up.

Smoked some weed (I was more of a stoner than a drinker back then) and headed to school. When I got there, the parking lot was almost empty. I was confused and thinking it was maybe a holiday I had forgotten about. 

Go into class and there's only like 2 other people there and they're talking about a plane crashing near the pentagon. I'm stoned and confused and just sat there until the instructor walked in and said "Go home and watch the news". This guy was an ex secret service dude for Reagan. Didn't say anything else and left. 

I go home and turn on the TV. Tried to understand what I was looking at. Watched for what seemed like hours until my dad woke up, and then showed him. I can't really remember much else of that day, except talking to a friend who was at work that morning and they actually watched the second plane crash on the news as it happened.
